user.title: Connect a Scaleway account
user.description: Enter an API key from a Scaleway IAM user or application with read-only access to IAM, Billing, Instance, Kubernetes, and Object Storage. Add this integration again to track additional Organizations.

reauth_confirm.title: Update your Scaleway API key
reauth_confirm.description: The stored API key for Organization {organization_id} no longer works — it may have been revoked, or reached its expiry date. Enter a replacement key. Rotating a key produces a new access key and secret key, so both are needed. The replacement must belong to the same Organization.

reconfigure.title: Replace your Scaleway API key
reconfigure.description: Enter a new API key for Organization {organization_id} — for example after rotating or revoking the old one. Rotating a key produces a new access key and secret key, so both are needed, and the new key must belong to the same Organization. Your sensors, history and backup location are all kept.

buckets.title: Choose buckets to monitor for size
buckets.description: Getting a bucket's size means listing every object in it, so buckets are opt-in rather than all being monitored automatically. Leave empty to skip bucket size sensors. You can also pick a bucket here to use as an HA backup destination — it'll show up under Settings → System → Backups → Locations. All of this can be changed later from the integration's options.

data_description.backup_bucket: Optional. Each backup is written here as a .tar file plus a matching .metadata.json sidecar — Scaleway has no first-class backup concept to store that metadata in directly.
data_description.backup_prefix: Optional. Prepended to every backup object's key, e.g. 'homeassistant/' — useful if this bucket is shared with other things.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid access key or secret key.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Scaleway API.

abort.wrong_account: That API key belongs to a different Scaleway Organization. Use a key for the Organization this entry was set up with, or add a separate integration entry for the other Organization.

init.title: Choose buckets to monitor for size
init.description: Getting a bucket's size means listing every object in it, so buckets are opt-in rather than all being monitored automatically. The backup destination bucket controls whether this account shows up under Settings → System → Backups → Locations.

data_description.backup_prefix: Optional. Prepended to every backup object's key, e.g. 'homeassistant/'.
